mapper.insert: INSERT INTO board (sabun, title, content, file, views, created, updated) VALUES (#{sabun}, #{title}, #{content}, #{file}, 0, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT b.idx, b.sabun, s.saname, d.dname AS dept, leader.saname AS leader_name, b.title, b.content, b.file, b.views, b.created, b.updated FROM board b LEFT JOIN sawon s ON b.sabun = s.sabun LEFT JOIN dept d ON s.deptno = d.deptno LEFT JOIN sawonleader sl ON d.deptno = sl.deptno LEFT JOIN sawon leader ON sl.sabun = leader.sabun WHERE b.idx = #{idx}
SELECT sabun FROM sawonleader WHERE sabun = #{sabun}
